title: pseudophleum gibbum
intro: Pseudophleum gibbum, commonly known as Hoary Cress or Yellow Salsify, is a biennial plant species belonging to the family Brassicaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, particularly in the treatment of digestive issues, as it has been traditionally used to alleviate symptoms of diarrhea, dyspepsia, and indigestion. The therapeutic actions of Pseudophleum gibbum include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its use in treating respiratory conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Pseudophleum gibbum include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
